findings.claim: A cancelled order can transition back to paid, resurrecting a terminal cancellation and making the order eligible for downstream paid-order processing such as fulfillment or charging.
evidence: evals/cases/case_09/src/orders.py:6 explicitly includes paid in the allowed transitions for cancelled orders.
evals/cases/case_09/src/orders.py:10-15 applies any transition listed in ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS and returns a copy with the new status.
A direct runtime probe calling transition_order({"id": 9, "status": "cancelled"}, "paid") returned {"id": 9, "status": "paid"} without raising an error.
evals/cases/case_09/tests/test_orders.py:4-7 tests only created-to-paid and provides no regression coverage for cancellation finality.

uncertainties: The case does not include downstream payment or fulfillment integrations, so the exact external side effects of resurrecting a cancelled order cannot be directly verified here.
